The corrected assumption

A date warning
is not a rule.

The NY demo’s imported Mar 31, 2026 expiry field is unverified source-system metadata. The fictional accountant rejects a universal-expiry interpretation, while retaining the genuine entity/state mismatch.

The separate Florida annual-resale fixture uses Dec 31, 2025 as the prior-year certificate expiry. Its state/form context and alternative authorization question remain explicit.
